title.rendered: Cambridge spinout Fenwick Bio launches with seed funding

content.rendered:
Fenwick Bio, a new company spun out of the University of Cambridge, has launched with a seed round to develop synthetic enzymes for sustainable chemical production.

The technology comes out of eight years of work in the Department of Biochemistry. Cambridge Enterprise holds a founding equity stake alongside the two academic founders.

excerpt.rendered: Fenwick Bio, a Cambridge spinout, has launched with seed funding.

title.rendered: Cambridge researchers license drug discovery platform

content.rendered:
Researchers at the University of Cambridge have licensed a drug discovery platform to a major pharmaceutical partner in a multi-year deal.

The agreement covers three therapeutic areas and includes milestone payments to the university.

excerpt.rendered: Researchers at Cambridge have licensed a drug discovery platform.

title.rendered: Cambridge Enterprise appoints new head of technology transfer

content.rendered:
Cambridge Enterprise has appointed a new head of technology transfer, who joins from a research institute in Basel.

The role oversees licensing, consultancy and the seed fund team.

excerpt.rendered: Cambridge Enterprise has appointed a new head of technology transfer.

title.rendered: Photonics spin-out Lumenline raises £1.4m seed round

content.rendered:
Lumenline, a photonics spin-out from the Cavendish Laboratory, raises £1.4 million in a seed round led by a deeptech fund.

The company makes low-loss optical interconnects for data-centre switching and was incorporated in February.
